slots.node01.text: AI is cutting the time and cost of complex modernization by changing how teams analyze, design, build and test.
slots.node02.text: How are legacy systems holding your business back?
slots.node03.body.item01.p: Most legacy estates were built before AI. Mapping data, interfaces and controls first shows which systems block AI-enabled workflows and which are ready now.
slots.node03.label: AI-native readiness
slots.node03.title: How can you get your business ready to run on AI?
slots.node04.body.item01.p: Quarterly release trains slow every new idea. Modern, modular platforms let teams ship weekly, so a good idea reaches customers while it still matters.
slots.node04.label: Growth velocity
slots.node04.title: What products could you launch without release-cycle delays?
slots.title: The script has [[flipped]] on how companies approach modernization
